title: Fixed-paper DexVerse results with separate archive crosschecks
authority: The active text in ExtendedAbstract/main.tex and Figure 2 (figs/heldout_pair.png). Commented-out prose is not treated as an active paper claim.
metric: Mean per-task held-out success percent; unaccepted tasks count as zero in the archived protocol.

protocol.repeats_note: The source protocol uses the same 50 unseen configurations in both repeats, not 100 distinct configurations.

all_75.note: The active paper says more than 90% across the full benchmark. Its two subgroup means are rounded. Do not present their weighted average as an exact raw-campaign result. A0 archive independently verifies CEM at 94.52%.

comparison_interpretation.best_imitation_definition: For each task, take the highest success rate among pi0.5, OpenVLA, DP3 and DP; then average those 15 per-task maxima. The 46.0% value is not the mean of one fixed imitation policy.
comparison_interpretation.imitation_training: All four methods were trained using the same 950 teleoperation episodes (19 tasks × 50 episodes per task). Observation interfaces differ by method; see DexVerse Section 4.1 and Appendix B.
comparison_interpretation.program_synthesis_setting: The synthesized controllers use state observations and simulator feedback without expert demonstrations.
comparison_interpretation.comparison_scope: The comparison covers the same 15 tasks; the training resources and observation interfaces differ.

imitation_observations_by_method.pi0.5: RGB images and language; proprioceptive-state input disabled.
imitation_observations_by_method.OpenVLA: RGB images, joint positions and language.
imitation_observations_by_method.DP: Normalized proprioceptive state, without visual input.
imitation_observations_by_method.DP3: Point clouds and proprioception, without RGB or language input.

campaign_mapping.cem: The paper CEM results cross-check exactly against the 75 valid A0 rows from e1_pool10_A0, e2_wave1_A0 and e2_wave2_A0.
campaign_mapping.paper_agentic: The fixed paper calls this Agentic search. Its 13 rows shared with the supplied L3PG archive match exactly. The paper additionally shows BimanualLiftTray at 92% and FunctionalHammerStrike at 100%, and full-category aggregates over all 75 tasks. The supplied archive has no L3PG chains for the six E1 tasks, so a complete campaign mapping is unavailable.
campaign_mapping.earlier_L3P: The earlier 75-task L3+papers archive has 94.32% overall. It is a separate existing result and must not be substituted for paper Agentic search.
campaign_mapping.earlier_L3PG: The earlier 69-task L3PG archive has 91.55072463768116% overall. The original blog omits its three long-horizon tasks, leaving 66 tasks at 94.37878787878788%.

public_archive_check.finding: Public archive lists the same earlier campaigns; no E1 L3PG campaign is listed.

existing_blog_66_task_cohort.definition: The original blog uses the 69-task L3PG E2 cohort excluding its three long-horizon tasks. It is not the paper remainder of 60 tasks.
existing_blog_66_task_cohort.old_hero_note: The previous 97.3% hero value can be reproduced as the mean over 64 accepted L3PG policies in the 66-task cohort. Its previous label, 70 tasks across 5 domains, is not supported by this denominator; do not reuse that label.

paper_figure_2a.transcription: Values were read from the fixed paper figure; all CEM values and 13 of the 15 Agentic values cross-check against the supplied archives.

paper_figure_2b.transcription: Category values were read from the fixed paper figure; CEM aggregates cross-check against the supplied A0 archive. Agentic category values remain paper-reported, not reconstructed campaign summaries.
